arsdelight.patchouli.automation.page1: スペルがまな板に当たった時、スペルのグリフに基づいて道具をシュミレートし、まな板の上のアイテムを加工します。$(li)切断: ナイフまたはハサミ$(li)切断 + 増強: 斧またはナイフ$(li)切断 + 抽出: ハサミ$(li)破壊: ツルハシ$(li)粉砕: シャベル$(li)伐採: 斧$(br)範囲増強のオーグメントがあると、まな板の動作は行われず、元の呪文の効果が発動する
arsdelight.patchouli.automation.title: スペルキッチン
arsdelight.patchouli.category_desc: Ars Nouveauと連携機能を持ったArs Delightの機械・グリフ・アイテム
arsdelight.patchouli.drygmy_weapon.page1: Ars Delight 導入時、ドライグミーはドライグミーヘンジのすぐ隣にある儀式の台座にあるツールを使ってモブの戦利品をシミュレートできます。$(br2) この機能により、ドライグミーは Farmer's Delight とそのアドオンによるドロップ品を収集できます。
arsdelight.patchouli.drygmy_weapon.title: ドライグミーへ武器をもたせる
arsdelight.patchouli.effects.blast_resis: 爆発耐性の効果は爆破ダメージを1レベルごとに20%%軽減します。この効果は他のダメージ軽減の後に適用され、レベル5で爆破ダメージを完全に受けなくなります。
arsdelight.patchouli.effects.flourishing: 繁栄の効果は、対象のプレイヤーの効果中、体力回復時にマナも回復するようになります。$(br2)体力回復x%%ごとに同じ割合でマナが回復し、効果のレベルが上がるたびにマナ回復量か2倍になります。
arsdelight.patchouli.effects.page1: By cooking fruits from one archwood with barks from another, one can neutralize the negative effects into something new and activate more beneficial effects.$(br2)Food made with wilden drops will provide wilden effect that aids spell casting. Food with better ingredient gives higher level.
arsdelight.patchouli.effects.synchronize: Synchronized Shield effect will give absorption to player when player heals. Player gains same amount of absorption as their healing amount, up to a maximum amount determined by effect level.$(br2)Every level up doubles maximum absorption and amount of absorption gained
arsdelight.patchouli.effects.title: Food Effects
arsdelight.patchouli.effects.wilden: Wilden effect will increase player max mana, mana regeneration, and spell damage.$(br2)By default, each level increases 20%% max mana, mana regen, and spell damage. The number can be tweaked individually in config.
arsdelight.patchouli.enchanters_knife: Applies a Touch spell before damaging an entity. Apply a spell at the Scribesのテーブル that does NOT contain a form, such as Ignite -> Extend Time.$(br2)Unlike Enchanter's Sword, it does not provide additional Amplify augment.
arsdelight.patchouli.jelly.page1: Archwood pod jellies are made from archwood fruits and barks, with enhanced fruit effect. Jelly on ground bounces up falling entities and applies jelly effect.$(br2)Spell projectiles can pass through jelly blocks. If the spell has infuse effect, override the potion effect, then it won't consume potions.
arsdelight.patchouli.jelly.title: Archwood Pod Jelly
arsdelight.patchouli.resources.barks: Player can gather archwood barks by cutting archwood logs with axe on cutting table.$(br2)Archwood barks is widely used in cooking to boost effect of pods from the same archwood tree or convert effect of pods from a different archwood tree
arsdelight.patchouli.resources.chimera_h: Player can gather キメラHorn by killing キメラwith an axe.$(br2)It's a reusable food container and can boost food effect.
arsdelight.patchouli.resources.chimera_m: Player can gather キメラMeat in bulk by killing キメラwith a knife.$(br2)It's very nutritious and gives strong wilden effect when cooked properly.
arsdelight.patchouli.resources.page1: Ars Delight adds several ingredients player can collect with tools:$(li)Archwood Barks$(li)Wilden Meat$(li)キメラMeat$(li)キメラHorn
arsdelight.patchouli.resources.title: Natural Resources
arsdelight.patchouli.resources.wilden_me: Player can gather Wilden Meat by killing Wilden Hunter with a knife.$(br2)It's fairly nutritious and is the early game source of wilden effect.

bluearchive.attachment.grip_fuuka.name: 給食部の護身用銃typeA グリップ
bluearchive.attachment.grip_fuuka.toolti:
フウカのグリップ, which often used by the experienced hand 
that had gone through knife wounds. It even gives some aroma of the 
dishes she cooked. Will it improve cooking skill after using it?
bluearchive.attachment.grip_kurumi.name: FOX-45 サブマシンガン グリップ
bluearchive.attachment.grip_kurumi.toolt:
A reliable and simple grip
if you touch it without permission, Kurumi will smack you so hard that you'll be sent flying
bluearchive.attachment.grip_otogi.name: FOX-82 スナイパーライフル トライポッド
bluearchive.attachment.grip_otogi.toolti:
Although it is a simple and reliable tripod, occasionally it struggles to stabilize the firearm.
just a adorable little blunders that a cute tripod often makes on the battlefield～
bluearchive.attachment.grip_shiroko.name: WHITE FANG 456 グリップ
bluearchive.attachment.grip_shiroko.tool:
シロコのグリップ。単純で信頼性の高い構造により、
よりあらゆる状況に対応できる。
力強い左手の握力により、拭い切れない傷がついている。
bluearchive.attachment.grip_yukino.name: FOX-416 アサルトライフル's grip
bluearchive.attachment.grip_yukino.toolt: A grip that's ease to use, it's so easy that the prison have a rule to avoid it's getting use as a door handler
bluearchive.attachment.laser_yukino.name: FOX-416 アサルトライフル's laser pointer
bluearchive.attachment.laser_yukino.tool: A laser pointer thats so ease to use, it is so good if the warden finds out, you'll end up in solitary confinement.
bluearchive.attachment.muzzle_fuuka.name: 給食部の護身用銃typeA サプレッサー
bluearchive.attachment.muzzle_fuuka.tool:
フウカのサプレッサー, as she often have to deal with the 
troublemakers, perhaps in the shadows where shouldn't to be known,
 this supprepsor played an important role...
bluearchive.attachment.muzzle_miyako.nam: Rabiit-31式短機関銃 サイレンサー
bluearchive.attachment.muzzle_miyako.too:
SRT特殊学園の標準サイレンサー。標準装備のため安く、
売ったとしても駐車場以外で寝るお金にはならないだろう。
bluearchive.attachment.muzzle_wakamo.too:
A tiny little attachment that let you learn how to use bayonet immediately
Don't lose it... Wait, does it even matter if you do?
bluearchive.attachment.scope_fuuka.name: 給食部の護身用銃typeA スコープ
bluearchive.attachment.scope_fuuka.toolt:
フウカのスコープ, used to accurately subdue the troublemakers.
 Other than the scope itself, it also requires a firm grip with hands
 honed through years of cooking to ensure the accuracy
bluearchive.attachment.scope_kurumi.name: FOX-45 サブマシンガン サイト
bluearchive.attachment.scope_kurumi.tool:
Another simple and reliable sight
Kurumi doesn’t remove the original sights when attaching it?won’t it block her view?
bluearchive.attachment.scope_miyako.name: Rabiit-31式短機関銃 サイト
bluearchive.attachment.scope_miyako.tool:
SRT特殊学園の標準サイト。標準装備のため安く、
闇市場では内蔵バッテリーよりも安い値段で取引されている。
bluearchive.attachment.scope_miyuu.name: RABBIT-39式小銃 スコープ
bluearchive.attachment.scope_miyuu.toolt:
The scope that has made significant contributions to every mission
Due to its owner's influence, even if a shot misses, the enemy has no idea where the bullet came from
...Isn't this basically a natural-born assassin?
bluearchive.attachment.scope_niko.name: FOX-870 ショットガン's sight
bluearchive.attachment.scope_niko.toolti:
A reliable and simple sight, as dependable as a mother’s embrace.
This sight was a sight which may become a mother to me
bluearchive.attachment.scope_noa.name: 書記の採決 スコープ
bluearchive.attachment.scope_noa.tooltip:
The scope paired with the stock can somehow be detached for some reason.
It’s often only useful after the stock is extended.
bluearchive.attachment.scope_otogi.name: FOX-82 スナイパーライフル ハイパワースコープ
bluearchive.attachment.scope_otogi.toolt:
A simple and reliable high-power scope
if you mess with it while Otogi just spent hours to adjusted it
she will be so shocked that she’ll be frozen in place for an entire day
bluearchive.attachment.scope_serika.name: シンシアリティ スコープ
bluearchive.attachment.scope_serika.tool:
「シャーレの歴史家記録」によると、セリカのスコープは
「暗殺に適しているが、実際はポイ捨てされた
ペットボトルを見つけるのによく使われた」
と記されていて、「後期キヴォトス記」にも
同様の記録がある。
bluearchive.attachment.scope_shiroko.too:
シロコのスコープ。消えない傷がいっぱい。
このスコープを使えば現金輸送車を見逃すことはない。
bluearchive.attachment.scope_toki.name: シークレットタイム スコープ
bluearchive.attachment.scope_toki.toolti:
Secret Time's scope. with its cold and sleek appearance, resembles its owner.
Although it looks quite sci-fi, it can’t auto-aim… or rather, it shouldn't be able to auto-aim, right?
bluearchive.attachment.scope_yukino.name: FOX-416 アサルトライフル's sight
bluearchive.attachment.scope_yukino.tool: A sight that's even more ease to use, it's so good that it's forbidden in the prison
bluearchive.gun.ayane.name: コモンセンス
bluearchive.gun.ayane.tooltip:
アヤネが振り回しているかわいいピストル。
彼女の前で常軌を逸した発言や行動を繰り返さない限り、
めったに見られるものではない。
bluearchive.gun.azusa.name: §4Et Omnia Vanitas
bluearchive.gun.azusa.tooltip: A gun that Azusa always holds tightly.The barrel is engraved with the phrase, 'All is in vain. No matter how far you go, it's all just emptiness.'
bluearchive.gun.fuuka.name: §4給食部の護身用銃typeA
bluearchive.gun.fuuka.tooltip: フウカが肌身離さず持ち歩いているサブマシンガン。She sometimes tries to use it to subdue the troublemakers in the cafeteria, but most of the time they quiet down before she can use it, so she doesn't seem to get much use out of it.
bluearchive.gun.hina.name: §5終幕:デストロイヤー
bluearchive.gun.hina.tooltip:
ヒナが自分の手のように扱うマシンガン。
校則を破ったり、風紀を乱したりする者は
その容赦なき破壊力に吹き飛ばされる。
bluearchive.gun.hoshino.name: §dEYES OF HORUS
bluearchive.gun.hoshino.tooltip:
ホシノお気に入りの単純なショットガン。
彼女は怠け者だが、銃のメンテナンスを怠ることは決してない。
bluearchive.gun.ibuki.name: §4バンバーン！ちゃん
bluearchive.gun.ibuki.tooltip: A gun that Ibuki treasures. Ibuki has attached her favorite stickers and accessories to the standard rifle she inherited from her senior at Pandemonium Society. It is said to be an irreplaceable treasure for Ibuki.
bluearchive.gun.iroha.name: §4万魔殿制式拳銃
bluearchive.gun.iroha.tooltip: The pistol carried by Iroha.As the tank commander of Pandemonium, she has few opportunities to use it, and she always says that it is troublesome to carry around even in this size. But even so, the fact that it is neatly maintained every day shows Iroha's character.
bluearchive.gun.kurumi.name: §6FOX-45 サブマシンガン
bluearchive.gun.kurumi.tooltip: Kurumi was issued a regulation Submachine gun by the SRT Special Academy. Combined with her shield, it makes her the tank of her team
bluearchive.gun.mika.name: §dQuis ut Deus
bluearchive.gun.mika.tooltip: A submachine gun that Mika loves. An ordinary submachine gun made by Trinity, decorated with Mika's heart. Now it has a special appearance that shines like a star even in the darkness. Works for Mika anytime, anywhere.
bluearchive.gun.miku.name: §5ライブ用Tシャツキャノン
bluearchive.gun.miku.tooltip: A huge cannon used by Hatsune Miku to distribute merchandise such as T-shirts during her live performances.The surface lights up in sync with the music.
bluearchive.gun.miyako.name: §bRabiit-31式短機関銃
bluearchive.gun.miyako.tooltip:
SRT特殊学園からミヤコに支給された制式短機関銃。
極限状態に耐え、敵を薙ぎ倒す信頼性の高い銃である。
bluearchive.gun.miyuu.name: RABBIT-39式小銃
bluearchive.gun.miyuu.tooltip: Regulation sniper rifle issued to Miyu by the SRT Special Academy.Finely made and boasts an amazing accuracy.
bluearchive.gun.momoi.name: §dユニーク・アイディア
bluearchive.gun.momoi.tooltip: An assault rifle used by Momoi.She has an accessory given to her by his dear sister, and when she is in trouble, she plays with it and it seems to spark an idea.
bluearchive.gun.natsu.name: ビヨンド・ザ・ルミネーション
bluearchive.gun.natsu.tooltip: The submachine gun that Natsu carries.For her, who basically likes to contemplate, taking out this gun is often a 'last resort'
bluearchive.gun.niko.name: §5FOX-870 ショットガン
bluearchive.gun.niko.tooltip: Niko was issued a regulation shotgun by the SRT Special Academy, it's powerfull close-range burst damage, making it an essential partner for her
bluearchive.gun.noa.name: §1書記の採決
bluearchive.gun.noa.tooltip: Noa uses a pistol with a conversion kit.With the stock extended, it can be fired like a submachine gun.(lie)。
bluearchive.gun.nonomi.name: §2リトルマシンガンV
bluearchive.gun.nonomi.tooltip:
ノノミの愛用マシンガン。
「リトル」とは名ばかりで、銃器としてはかなり大きい。
bluearchive.gun.otogi.name: §2FOX-82 スナイパーライフル
bluearchive.gun.otogi.tooltip: Otogi was issued a regulation Sniper rifle by the SRT Special Academy, which provides the team with reliable long-range fire support by it's terrifying accuracy
bluearchive.gun.serika.name: §4シンシアリティ
bluearchive.gun.serika.tooltip:
セリカがアルバイトに出かけるときに持ち歩くアサルトライフル。
丁寧にメンテナンスされていて、彼女の几帳面さと誠実さが伺える。
bluearchive.gun.shiroko.name: §bWHITE FANG 465
bluearchive.gun.shiroko.tooltip:
シロコお気に入りのアサルトライフル。
常に整備が行き届いていて、何が起きてもいつでも対応できる。
bluearchive.gun.toki.name: §bシークレットタイム
bluearchive.gun.toki.tooltip: It has the performance to match its appearance and eliminates all targets that interfere with her mission.Toki didn't choose the name, somebody else named it.
bluearchive.gun.wakamo.name: §4真紅の災厄
bluearchive.gun.wakamo.tooltip: Wakamo's favorite rifle.Contrary to its old-fashioned appearance, it always smells of flame and gunpowder. Currently, it is often fired at 'obstacles' around the teacher's surroundings.
bluearchive.gun.wakamoswim.name: §9真紅の災厄(水着)
bluearchive.gun.wakamoswim.tooltip: Wakamo's favorite rifle.Just like Wakamo's buoyant mood as summer arrives, the muzzle of the rifle emits intense scorching crimson sparks toward all who stand in its way.
bluearchive.gun.yukino.name: §6FOX-416 アサルトライフル
bluearchive.gun.yukino.tooltip: Yukino was issued a regulation assault rifle by the SRT Special Academy, it's reliable in any distance and suitable for a squad leader to carry
bluearchive.workbench.desc:
プリンターを精製台に設置してある
なんとかシッテムの箱がなくても動作している。

jei.railcraft.desc.block_signal: カート検知に使用される基本的な信号です。隣接する区画信号と一対一の関係にあり、その間にあるカートを検知し、その結果を対になる受信機に送信します。
jei.railcraft.desc.disposable_battery: 充電ネットワークと連携するために設計された電池です。安価で使い捨てに適しています。満充電の状態で提供されます。
jei.railcraft.desc.disposable_battery_em: 充電ネットワークと連携するために設計された電池です。安価で使い捨てに適しています。この電池は空で、粉砕機でリサイクルできます。
jei.railcraft.desc.distant_signal: このタイプの信号は、主に装飾用として使用されます。これはカートと全く連動せず、単に対になる制御器から送られた状態を表示します。
jei.railcraft.desc.dual_block_signal: この信号には上部のランプに標準的な区画信号、下部に遠方信号が含まれています。制御器であり、受信機でもあります。
jei.railcraft.desc.dual_distant_signal: この信号には2つの遠方信号が含まれています。異なる制御器と対になることができます。
jei.railcraft.desc.dual_token_signal: この信号には上部のランプに通票信号、下部に遠方信号が含まれています。制御器であり、受信機でもあります。
jei.railcraft.desc.feed_station: 近くの動物を自動的に餌付けできる装置です。レッドストーンで無効化できます。過剰な繁殖を防ぐため、近くにいる動物が多すぎる場合は餌付けを停止します。
jei.railcraft.desc.logbook: 記帳は、このブロックから16ブロックの範囲内を通過するプレイヤーと、そのプレイヤーが訪れた日付を記録します。所有者以外は破壊できません。
jei.railcraft.desc.manual_rolling_machin: 金属を様々な形状に圧延する機械です。グリッド内のアイテムが1サイクル分しかない場合、出力表示をクリックして強制的にクラフトできます。
jei.railcraft.desc.nickel_iron_battery: 充電ネットワークと連携するために設計された電池です。一般的な用途に適しています。
jei.railcraft.desc.nickel_zinc_battery: 充電ネットワークと連携するために設計された電池です。低消費電力で、長期間の使用に適しています。
jei.railcraft.desc.powered_rolling_machi: 金属を様々な形状に圧延する機械です。アイテムをパイプで搬入出できるようにするだけで自動化することができます。グリッド内のアイテムが1サイクル分しかない場合、出力表示をクリックして強制的にクラフトできます。
jei.railcraft.desc.token_signal: この信号は、カートの出入りを監視するためのエリアを定義するために使用できます。エリアを定義するための信号のネットワークと組み合わされ、エリアを定義する信号の数に特に制限はありません。分岐点や対角線に推奨されます。その結果得られた状態を対になる受信器に送信します。
jei.railcraft.desc.tunnel_bore: トンネルの掘削と線路の敷設を行うために設計された機械です。

manual.railcraft.routing_table.page.1: 経路検知器や分岐器に配置された経路表は、通過するすべての機関車と一致する一連のルールを定義します。これらのルールは、好みに応じてシンプルまたは複雑なルールを作成できるようにする簡単なロジック構文を使用して定義されます。この構文は接頭辞記法スクリプトであり、演算子の後に被演算子が続きます。1行に1つのキーワードのみが許可されます。演算子が指定されていない場合、ORが仮定されます。経路表は、クラフトグリッドに複数配置することでコピーできます。
manual.railcraft.routing_table.page.10:
結果：
  前のページのスクリプトは以下の条件に
  一致する機関車を取得します：
  目的地が "TheFarLands/Milliways"の機関車
  または黒色と赤色で塗装された機関車
  または目的地が "SecretHideout/OceanEntrance"の機関車
  ただし、これらの条件は所有者が
  Steveでない場合にのみ適用されます。
manual.railcraft.routing_table.page.11:
正規表現：
  一部の条件は正規表現をサポートしています。
  正規表現を使用するには、
  '='の前に'?'を追加してください（半角記号）
  Javaの正規表現パターンに従ってください。
サポートされている条件：
  Dest, Name
例：
  Dest?=.*Hill
manual.railcraft.routing_table.page.12:
アナログ出力：
  整数定数を使用してアナログ出力を
  行うことができます。整数とIF文は、
  トップレベルでのみ、またはIF文の
  thenまたはelseとして使用できます。
  TRUEとFALSEはいつでも使用できます。
例：
  IF
  Dest=Town
  8
  IF
  Dest=City
  4
  FALSE
manual.railcraft.routing_table.page.2:
演算子のキーワード：
  AND - 2つの被演算子、
  両方がtrueである必要があります。
  OR - 2つの被演算子、
  1つがtrueである必要があります。
  NOT - 次の被演算子を反転します。
  IF - 3つの被演算子：cond, then, else。
      condがtrueの場合、thenを使用します。
      そうでない場合は、elseを使用します。
manual.railcraft.routing_table.page.3:
条件のキーワード：
  Dest=<string>
    機関車の目的地の文字列が
    この文字列で始まる場合、
    条件はtrueになります。
    "Dest=null"は目的地のない
    カートにマッチします。
  Owner=<username>
    機関車がその人物の
    所有物の場合trueになります。
manual.railcraft.routing_table.page.4:
条件のキーワード：
  Name=<entityname>
    トロッコの名前と
    一致する場合trueになります。
    "Name=null"はカスタム名が
    ないカートに一致します。
  Type=<modid:itemname>
    トロッコのアイテム名と
    一致する場合trueになります。
manual.railcraft.routing_table.page.5:
条件のキーワード：
  Rider=<type>[:<qualifier>]
    乗客が一致する場合trueになります
        シンプルなタイプ：
          any, none, mob, animal, unnamed
        修飾子を使用できるタイプ：
          player, named, entity
        正規表現を使用できるタイプ：
          player, named
        例についてはGitHub Issue #844を
        参照してください
manual.railcraft.routing_table.page.6:
条件のキーワード：
  Color=<primary>,<secondary>
    機関車の主色と副色が
    一致する場合trueになります。
    "Any"をワイルドカードとして受け入れます。
    色：黒色, 赤色, 緑色, 茶色, 青色,
    紫色, 青緑色, Light灰色, 灰色, 桃色, 黄緑色,
    黄色, 空色, 赤紫色,  橙色, 白色の
  NeedsRefuel=<true/false>
    もし機関車の燃料や水が不足している場合、
    機関車を迂回させます。
manual.railcraft.routing_table.page.7:
条件のキーワード：
  赤色stone=<true/false>
    経路ブロックにレッドストーン信号が
    入力されている場合trueになります。
manual.railcraft.routing_table.page.8:
条件のキーワード：
  Loco=<string>
    機関車がパラメータ文字列に
    一致する場合trueになります。
    受け入れられる文字列：
    electric（電気）, steam（蒸気）,
    creative（クリエイティブ）, none（なし）。
    パラメータにnoneを使用すると、
    機関車が存在しない場合のみtrueを返します。
manual.railcraft.routing_table.page.9:
サンプルスクリプト：
  Dest=TheFarLands
  Color=黒色,赤色
  AND
  NOT
  Owner=Steve
  Dest=SecretHideout/OceanEntrance

ritual.bloodmagic.speedRitual.vengeful.i: (Vengeful) Prevents adult mobs and players from being transported. Players are transported if paired with Destructive.
ritual.bloodmagic.sphereRitual.info: Cracks open the ground, transporting a spheroid from the ground into the air. The shape extracted will be a spheroid of the designated size.

ritual.bloodmagic.suppressionRitual.info: Suppresses fluids within its range - deactivating the ritual returns the fluids back to the world.
ritual.bloodmagic.suppressionRitual.supp: (Suppress) All liquids within the range are suppressed.
ritual.bloodmagic.upgradeRemoveRitual.in: Removes all upgrades from your Living Armor and gives you the corresponding Upgrade Tomes. These Tomes can be used to re-apply them to your Living Armor.
ritual.bloodmagic.waterRitual.info: Generates a source of water from the Master Ritual Stone.
ritual.bloodmagic.waterRitual.waterRange: (Water) The area within which the Ritual will place Water Source Blocks.
(Raw) The tank that the ritual will place water into.
(Altar) The area that the ritual searches for a 血の祭壇 to deposit its Blood into.
(Damage) All mobs within this area will take damage every second or so until they die. This does not include players, fortunately.

ritual.bloodmagic.yawningVoidRitual.defa: (Raw) Increases the speed of the ritual based on the total amount of Raw Will in the Aura.
ritual.bloodmagic.yawningVoidRitual.info: Destroys blocks within a large area.
ritual.bloodmagic.yawningVoidRitual.plac: (Placement) Based on Will config, blocks not destroyed are placed within range.
ritual.bloodmagic.yawningVoidRitual.stea: (Steadfast) Non-destroyed blocks are placed in separate region. If no filter applied, all blocks are moved.

text.industrialforegoing.book.animal_gro: When provided with power and {breeding} food, it will feed baby animals to make them {grow} faster.
text.industrialforegoing.book.animal_ind: When provided with power it will move {baby} animals from the back to the front.@L@@L@If {Adult Filter} is installed it will move adult animals instead of baby animals.
text.industrialforegoing.book.animal_res: When provided with power it will try to interact animals with {buckets} and {shears} to milk cows and shear sheeps.@L@@L@It will also get {ink sacks} from squids.
text.industrialforegoing.book.animal_sto: When provided with power and {food} for the animals it will feed them and put them in the mood. It needs the breeding item for the animal.\@L@\@L@There can only be {35} animals at the same time in the working area.
text.industrialforegoing.book.biofuel_ge: Produces power when provided with Biofuel. A {bucket} of biofuel will produce 160RF/t, a total {640,000}RF. About {28} generators can be run from 1 {Bioreactor}.
text.industrialforegoing.book.bioreactor: When provided with {power} and {bio materials} will produce {biofuel}.@L@@L@Each item will increase the efficiency of all the items by {10}mb, at maximum efficiency, the reactor will produce {1440}mb consuming {9} different items.
text.industrialforegoing.book.black_hole: It can hold 9 {ブラックホールユニットs} and access its items. That means 9 times {2,147,483,647} of items.
It can can hold up to {2,147,483,647}mb of one fluid.
It can can hold up to {2,147,483,647} of one item.
text.industrialforegoing.book.block_dest: When provided with power, it will {break} any block in front of it and move it to its inventory.
text.industrialforegoing.book.block_plac: When provided with power, it will {place} in front of it the blocks in its inventory.
text.industrialforegoing.book.conveyor_u: The blinking upgrade is placed in the center part of the conveyor and it will {teleport} entities in a short range in front of the conveyor. @L@@L@It has a {filter} with whitelist or blacklist and you can filter mobs by using a {Mob Imprisonment Tool} with an entity in it. The teleport {distance} can be configured in the GUI.

The bouncing upgrade is placed in the center part of the conveyor and it will {launch} entites in the air in the direction the conveyor is facing.@L@@L@It has a {filter} with whitelist or blacklist and you can filter mobs by using a {Mob Imprisonment Tool} with an entity in it. The {velocity} values (horizontal and vertical) can be changed in the GUI.

The detection upgrade is placed in the center part of the conveyor and will emmit a {redstone} signal when triggered by an entity.@L@@L@It has a {filter} with whitelist or blacklist and you can filter mobs by using a {Mob Imprisonment Tool} with an entity in it. The {redstone control} can be inverted in the GUI.

The dropping upgrade is placed in the center part of the conveyor and it will {drop} entities directly below it or insert items in inventories below it.@L@@L@It has a {filter} with whitelist or blacklist and you can filter mobs by using a {Mob Imprisonment Tool} with an entity in it.

The extraction upgrade will try to {extract} items from the inventories that are touching the upgrade and place them inside of the conveyor. @L@@L@It has a {filter} with whitelist or blacklist and it can be upgraded with {glowstone dust} to speed up the extaction. (It will stop extracting if it extracted too many items that aren't picked up)

The insertion upgrade will try to {insert} items that are touching the upgrade into the inventory touching the upgrade side. @L@@L@It has a {filter} with whitelist or blacklist for the insertion. The {range} can be increased in the GUI so it will pick up all the items in the conveyor instead of the items just touching the upgrade.

The splitting upgrade will {distribute} entities evenly, or with the configured ratio, to the side the upgrade is placed.@L@@L@The more {ratio} it has the more entities will go that way. The ratio can be configured in the GUI.
text.industrialforegoing.book.conveyors: Conveyors will {push} any entites to the direction they are facing. They come on different colors and verticality.@L@@L@They can be upgraded by right-clicking them with {glowstone dust} and the will move entities faster. Right-clicking them with {plastic} will prevent the items from being picked up.@PAGE@It also has a different {upgrades} that can be attached to the sides or the center of the conveyor. They will be placed on the {further} side of the conveyor. Upgrades can be removed by sneak + right clicking on it.
text.industrialforegoing.book.crop_enric: When provided with power and fertilizer it will bonemeal crops and saplings.@L@@L@Accepted fertilizers: {bonemeal}, {Industrial Foregoing's} and {Forestry} fertilizer.
text.industrialforegoing.book.crop_recol: When provided with power it will {harvest} fully grown crops and chop down trees, this includes pumpkins, melons and nether wart. Each operation will produce a bit of {sludge} that can be used in the {Sludge Refiner} to obtain some material. (Having the tank full will {not} slow the machine)
text.industrialforegoing.book.crop_sower: Plants seeds and saplings to be gathered in the {Plant Gatherer}. You can {lock} the slots by clicking in the lock and it will {filter} the inputs.@L@@L@The {colored} background represents the colored parts in the {top} of the block.
text.industrialforegoing.book.dye_mixer: It will produce {dye} more efficiently that normal crafting.@L@@L@Giving it {red} dye, {green} dye and {blue} dye will fill the color buffers. When given a {Laser Lens} will focus that color and produce the specified dye.
text.industrialforegoing.book.enchantmen: When provided with power it will act like an {anvil} but instead of player experience levels it will use {Essence} to achieve it.
When provided with power, a {book} and a {enchanted} item it will remove {1} enchantment from the item and apply it to the book.@L@@L@The enchanted item won't be damaged in the process.
When provided with power, an {enchanteable} item and {Essence} it will enchant the item just like an {enchanting table} does.@L@@L@It will use {3} buckets of Essence to do a {30} level enchant.
When provided with power and {any} item it will {sort} enchanted items from non enchanted items.@L@@L@Enchanted items will go to the {top} row and the non enchanted ones will go to the {bottom} row.
text.industrialforegoing.book.energy_fie: The {Energy Field Addon} is an item that will go into the addon slots of any working machine. It will give {power} to the machines from its internal buffer.@L@@L@The {Energy Field Provider} will charge the internal buffer of the addons that are {linked} to it and are in its {range}.
text.industrialforegoing.book.fluid_craf: The {fluid crafter} will craft anything that needs {one} fluid type instead of using the {buckets} in the recipe. To make it work you need to put the items in the grid and {lock it}. After that you can supply the items in the grid and the fluid in the tank.@L@@L@If the recipe has multiple of one item you can use {Item Splitter} to use it easier.
text.industrialforegoing.book.fluid_pump: When placed above a fluid, the Fluid Pump will take that fluid as a {filter} and begin to drain all fluids of the same type in the working area, it will search all the fluids {below} the fluids in the working area and drain them too. @L@@L@All the drained fluids will be replaced with {cobblestone}.
text.industrialforegoing.book.fluiddicti: This machine will transform similar fluids from different mods. You can check {JEI} for possible recipes. You simply need to click on the buttons to select the fluid.
text.industrialforegoing.book.fortune_ad: It will add {fortune/looting} to the machines that accept the addon. It needs to be enchanted with {Fortune} and it will use the enchantment level for the machine actions.
text.industrialforegoing.book.froster: The froster allows you to create cold substances by spinning the supplied {water} at very fast speeds and reducing the temperature using {power}.
text.industrialforegoing.book.hydrator: When provided with power it will increase the {grow speed} of the crops in the working area.
text.industrialforegoing.book.infinity_d: A powerful drill that has lost all of it's power. By recharging it will allow you to destroy worlds at a bigger rates. The more power it has, the bigger areas it can mine. In order to preserve that energy it can use {Biofuel} at a more efficient rate. Shift+Right Clicking it will allow you to change the mining area. @L@@L@{It holds secrets that can be easily achieved by Patreons and some rare mobs in the world.}
text.industrialforegoing.book.item_split: It will {split} the defined stack size on each slot of the allowed sides of the {output}.
text.industrialforegoing.book.landing: IF you need to automate all the things!
text.industrialforegoing.book.laser_base: When fully charged with {Laser Drills} it will produce ores based on depth and biome.@L@@L@You can increase the chance of producing an ore by adding {Laser Lens} to it.@L@@L@You can decrease the chance of an ore by using an {Laser Lens (Inverted)}, that will increase the chance of the other ores a bit.@L@@L@{Check JEI for chances}.
text.industrialforegoing.book.laser_dril: When placed {1} block away of a {Laser Base} it will charge it with power.@L@@L@If it is wrongly placed it will have a name tag on top telling you so.
text.industrialforegoing.book.latex_proc: When provided with {power}, {water} and {latex} will produce tiny dry rubber.@L@@L@It will consume {75}mb of latex and {1000}mb of water to produce {1} tiny dry rubber.
text.industrialforegoing.book.lava_fabri: When provided with large amounts of power, it will produce {lava}.
text.industrialforegoing.book.material_s: When provided with power it will start generating {cobblestone}. It has {4} operations that the machine can do. It can {smelt} items, {2x2} craft them, it can {grind} them and it can {3x3} craft them.@L@@L@For example, the first slot has cobble and the first operation is 'Smelt', then the cobble will turn into stone, the second operation is 2x2 craft, then the stone will turn into stone bricks, etc.
text.industrialforegoing.book.meat_feede: When the Meat Feeder is in your {inventory} and has some {Liquid Meat} in it, will automatically {feed} you.@L@@L@It acts like a normal fluid container.
text.industrialforegoing.book.mob_detect: It will emit a {赤色stone Signal} to the back depending on the amount of entities in front of it.
text.industrialforegoing.book.mob_duplic: When provided with power, {Essence} and any entity in a {Mob Imprisonment Tool} it will spawn them around it.@L@@L@It will {count} the entities nearby and stop spawning if there are too many.
text.industrialforegoing.book.mob_impris: When right clicked an entity with the item in the hand it will {hold} the entity inside it.
text.industrialforegoing.book.mob_reloca: When provided with power it will {kill} any entity in front of it as if a player would.@L@@L@It will {collect} the dropped items and it will transform the experience orbs into {Essence}". When having the {Adult Filter Addon} it will kill only adult mobs.
text.industrialforegoing.book.mob_slaugh: When provided with power it will {grind} any entity in front of it and produce {Liquid Meat} from it.@L@@L@It will {not} drop items or experience in the process.@L@@L@It will also produce {some pink} slime in the process.
text.industrialforegoing.book.ore_fermen: When provided with {raw ore meat} it will be processed into {fermented ore meat} and growing it's size. It needs a {hot source}(hot fluids, fire, magma blocks) on the bottom and a {cold fluid}(cold fluids, ice, ...) in any other side.
text.industrialforegoing.book.ore_proces: It will break down {Silk Touched} ores into its drops.@L@@L@Providing it with {Essence} break them with fortune.
text.industrialforegoing.book.ore_sieve: When provided with {fermented ore meat} and a little bit of {sand}, it will filter the ore from the meat and transform it into {dust}.
text.industrialforegoing.book.ore_washer: When provided with {liquid meat} and an {ore} it will wash the ore bits with meat into {raw ore meat} for further processing.
text.industrialforegoing.book.orediction: It will transform items with the same {oredicted} entry into the filtered item.
text.industrialforegoing.book.petrified_: When provided with any {solid fuel} will produce power. The {RF}/tick is decided from its burn time, the more {burn time} the fuel has the more {RF}/tick it will produce.@L@@L@NOTE: All fuels burn the same time.
text.industrialforegoing.book.pink_slime: Can be obtained by killing a {桃色 Slime} that will spawned when placing some {桃色 Slime Fluid} in the world.
text.industrialforegoing.book.pitiful_fu: Works the same as the Petrified Fuel Generator but it only accepts {wood} stuf.
text.industrialforegoing.book.plant_inte: When provided with power, it will {right click} crops and fruits to harvest them and store them in its inventory or drop them in the ground if they can't be stored. @L@@L@{*It works with Pam's Fruits and Plants by default.}
text.industrialforegoing.book.potion_ene: When provided with power it will act like an advanced version of the {brewing stand}.@L@@L@First of all it will {fill} glass bottles with water then it will start {brewing} all the ingredients in the top row in {order}, from left to right.@L@@L@Follow the {arrow} to check the current operation.
text.industrialforegoing.book.protein_ge: "Produces power when provided with Protein. A {bucket} of protein will produce 320RF/t, a total {1,280,000}RF.
text.industrialforegoing.book.protein_re: When provided with {power} and {some animals drops} will produce {protein}.@L@@L@Each item will increase the efficiency of all the items by {10}mb, at maximum efficiency, the reactor will produce {1440}mb consuming {9} different items.
text.industrialforegoing.book.range_addo: It will increase the working {range} of some machines. Not all of the machines will accept them.
text.industrialforegoing.book.resourcefu: It acts like a normal {furnace} but it can burn {3} items at a time and will produce a bit of {Essence} each time a item is smelted.
text.industrialforegoing.book.sewage_com: When provided with power and {2} buckets of Sewage, it will solidify it into {Fertilizer}.
text.industrialforegoing.book.sewer: When provided with power it will collect {Sewage} from the animals in top.
text.industrialforegoing.book.sludge_ref: When provided with power and {1} bucket of Sludge (Produced in the Plant Gatherer), it will produce {earth like} materials.@L@@L@{If JEI is installed look the uses of the Sludge Refiner to check the chance of the produced materials}.
text.industrialforegoing.book.spores_rec: When provided with power, {1} bucket of water and a {mushroom} of any kind it will grow them internally.
text.industrialforegoing.book.straw: It allows you to {drink} in world fluids or in tanks. It can cause different {effects} depending on the fluid.@L@@L@@L@@L@@L@(I'm not responsible of the bad effects that the straw can cause)
text.industrialforegoing.book.title: Industrial Foregoing's Manual
text.industrialforegoing.book.transfer_a: Transfer addons come in all the shapes and forms but only can transfer {items} and {fluids}, and they can pull and they can push.@L@@L@To change the direction of the action simply {right click} it to cycle between the directions or {shift right click} a side of a block to select that direction. You can enchant the addon with {Efficiency} to increase its transfer amount.
text.industrialforegoing.book.tree_fluid: When placed in front of any {log} it will produce {Liquid Latex}.@L@@L@It will slowly {consume} the log, each Tree Fluid Extractor contributes to the consuming of the log.
text.industrialforegoing.book.upgrades: Industrial Foregoing doesn't have speed upgrades but you can used {Energy Upgrades} and {Speed Upgrades} from Tesla Core Lib to speed up machines. They need the previous tier to be installed to be able to add the next one.
text.industrialforegoing.book.villager_t: When provided with power and a {Mob Imprisonent Tool} with a {Villager} in it, will give you access to automatically trade with the villager.
text.industrialforegoing.book.water_cond: When having {2} of more sides with water sources blocks it will start collecting water.@L@@L@The more sides with source blocks the more water it will produce.
text.industrialforegoing.book.water_reso: When placed over a pool of {3x3} pool of water it will automatically {fish}.
text.industrialforegoing.book.welcome_ma: Welcome to Industrial Foregoing's Manual!@L@@L@To get started you need to place a Tree Fluid Extractor in front of a log to collect ラテックスand pump into ラテックスProcessing Unit with some water to get Tiny Rubber. @L@@L@{NOTE: Machines don't auto eject, neither they pull! Machines accept RF, FE, Tesla and Mek power.}
text.industrialforegoing.book.wither_bui: When provided with power, {3} Wither Skulls and {4} soulsand, it will completely build the wither spawning structure in the working area.

trait.l2hostility.adaptive.desc: 受けたダメージを記録し、受けるたびに%s%%のダメージ軽減を得る。別のタイプの攻撃で%s番目のダメージの記録が消える。
trait.l2hostility.arena.desc: プレイヤーが周囲のブロック破壊・設置ができなくなる。また、この効果を受けていないエンティティからのダメージを無効化する。
trait.l2hostility.corrosion.desc: 対象へ攻撃時、ランダムな装備を%sつ選び、その耐久値消費を%s増やす。装備が足りない場合、与ダメージが%sずつ上昇する。
trait.l2hostility.counter_strike.desc: 攻撃を受けた時、次の攻撃力が上昇する。
trait.l2hostility.dementor.desc: 物理攻撃に耐性を持ち、攻撃が防具を貫通する。
trait.l2hostility.dispell.desc: 魔法攻撃に耐性を持ち、攻撃が魔法防護を貫通する。この時ランダムな%s個のエンチャントされたアイテムのエンチャントを%s秒封印する。
trait.l2hostility.drain.desc: 同じレベルのランダムなポーション効果を与える。攻撃時、%sつの有益な効果を除去し、有害な効果当たり%s攻撃力を増加し、その効果を%s、最大で%s秒延長する。
trait.l2hostility.erosion.desc: 攻撃時、ランダムな装備を%sつ選び、その耐久値を%s減らす。装備が足りない場合、与ダメージが%sずつ上昇する。
trait.l2hostility.fiery.desc: 攻撃時、対象と自身を%s秒燃やす。自身は火炎耐性を得る。
trait.l2hostility.gravity.desc: 周囲が高重力になる。攻撃を受けると対象を下方向に撃ち落とす
trait.l2hostility.grenade.desc: 榴弾を前弾消失から%s秒後に発射する。
trait.l2hostility.growth.desc: スライムが長い間最大体力でいる時、成長する。更に回復のトリートを得る。
trait.l2hostility.killer_aura.desc: %sの魔法ダメージを半径%sブロック以内のプレイヤーとエンティティに与え、s秒ごとにトリートの効果を与える。
trait.l2hostility.master.desc: 周囲に自身を守る子分を発生させる。
trait.l2hostility.pulling.desc: 周囲%sブロックのエンティティを引き寄せる。
trait.l2hostility.ragnarok.desc: 攻撃時、ランダムな%sつの装備を%s秒封印する。
trait.l2hostility.reflect.desc: 近接物理攻撃の%s%%を魔法ダメージで反射する。
trait.l2hostility.regenerate.desc: 毎秒最大体力の%s%%の体力を回復する。
trait.l2hostility.repelling.desc: 周囲%sブロックのエンティティを押しのけ、射撃物を無効化する。
trait.l2hostility.reprint.desc: エンチャントをコピーして、合計エンチャントレベルごとに%s攻撃力が増加する。
trait.l2hostility.shulker.desc: シュルカーの弾を前弾消失から%s秒後に発射する。
trait.l2hostility.split.desc: 倒れた時、自身のレベルの半分、同じトリートのクローンを2体召喚する。分裂ごとに召喚数は1つずつ減少する。
trait.l2hostility.teleport.desc: 物理ダメージ回避、対象追跡のためのテレポートを行う。
trait.l2hostility.undying.desc: 体力が0になった時、自身の体力を全回復する。
